review_classification: test-only hardening; the prepared base already contains the runtime fix
summary: The exact candidate adds a valid focused regression for a defect already fixed in its prepared-base parent. Independent testing reproduced the original pool_transfers_done override at the fixing commit's parent and verified the real timeout calculation plus boundary cases at the candidate. No runtime or native source changes are present in the candidate.

tests.what_was_measured: The candidate's four focused cases passed: timeout with pending/completed pool transfers, non-expired timeout, and non-timeout policy boundaries.

Failing-before reproduction using the real linear timeout predicate: the predicate was expired, but termination incorrectly returned false only while an auxiliary pool transfer remained pending. Two independent boundary cases passed.

Passing-after verification using the real timeout calculation: expired timeout with pending auxiliary transfer, expired timeout with completed auxiliary transfer, and non-expired timeout all followed the contract.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reviewed contract is CPU-only Python control flow. One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X was visible as gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, but no GPU kernel was needed or claimed.

remaining_limitations: No live HiCache plus Mooncake read-timeout integration deployment was available.
No full-model or distributed PP/TP workload was run; the review verifies the exact local timeout-decision contract.
